title: Virtual Head Attention: Cracking the KV Cache Trilemma

beats.text: Before you train your next model, see how Virtual Head Attention cuts 84.4% of memory overhead.
beats.visual_focus: A GPU memory bar hitting 100% capacity while the compute core idles.

beats.text: The Impossible Triangle forces a brutal choice: sacrifice cache size, prefill speed, or model quality. You lose one every time.
beats.visual_focus: A geometric triangle rotating with labels: Cache, Quality, Speed.

beats.text: Virtual Head Attention shatters this. It uses linear transformations to reconstruct head diversity from a tiny, compressed physical cache.
beats.visual_focus: A small data packet expanding into a high-dimensional representation.

feynman_certification.listener_verdict: Finally, a script that doesn't treat me like I'm five. The hook is aggressive and hits the exact pain point of running inference on consumer hardware. I actually understood the 'how' in Beat 4—mentioning that the math folds into existing weights is the kind of detail that makes me trust the content. No fluff, no 'magic' metaphors, just straight engineering.
